messages:
rebecca_customer: Hey team — since yesterday we're getting 400s on our calls to POST /v1/rerank. No code deploy on our side. Example response: `400 Bad Request` body: {"error":"invalid_request", "message":"candidates must be a non-empty array of objects with id and score"}`. Happens intermittently but lots of failed requests in the last hour. Posting the request body we send below.

rebecca_customer: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/rerank" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "query": "what is the best phone for photography",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "score": "0.92", "text": "Phone A specs..."},
    {"id": "c2", "score": 0.86, "text": "Phone B summary..."}
  ]
}'

rebecca_customer: Note the first candidate has score as a string (we thought SDK normalized it) — curious if strict server-side validation changed?

ashley_support: Thanks @rebecca_customer — sorry about the disruption. Can you share one full failing request/response pair including headers (with sensitive tokens redacted) and the exact timestamp for a failed call? Also useful: which SDK version or if you're calling raw HTTP.

rebecca_customer: Sent headers and the failing raw request via DM, ts: 1769001287. The response body is exactly: {"error":"invalid_request","message":"candidates must be a non-empty array of objects with id and score"} and no request_id in response.

ashley_support: Got it. Passing to infra and SDK folks. @mike_infra @ben_sdk can you take a look?

mike_infra: Looking at our ingress logs for ts ~1769001287. I see a 400 from the rerank handler with exception code BAD_PAYLOAD_VALIDATION. Server log excerpt: `ValidationError: candidates[0].score expected number but got string` — that matches rebecca's payload. Previously we tolerated numeric strings for scores, but a validation hardening went out in the rerank service yesterday to enforce types strictly. That would explain new 400s.

mike_infra: For mitigation we can (A) loosen server validation to coerce numeric strings to numbers for scores, or (B) advise callers to fix client payloads. Which path do we want?

ben_sdk: Quick note — our JS SDK (v1.4.2) used to serialize score as number when user passed number types, but if a user constructs the candidate objects from form inputs everything becomes strings. We shipped a tiny patch that normalizes candidate.score -> parseFloat when possible in v1.5.0. If the customer upgraded SDK recently maybe they landed on stricter validation before normalization.

rebecca_customer: We're on SDK v1.4.2 and did not upgrade. The app builds used a mapping that sometimes left score as string. We just patched to coerce scores client-side. Any chance for a short-term server-side fallback while we roll? We have spikes of traffic and this affects users.

mike_infra: We can push a one-line validation relax to accept numeric strings for scores for the next 24 hours while you deploy a fix. I'll schedule a quick canary patch targeted to rerank workers in region us-west-2.

ashley_support: Planned action: (1) infra will deploy a transient relax/compatibility change (canary first) — target ETA 30m, (2) ben will publish SDK guidance and a minor patch note to recommend upgrading to v1.5.0 which normalizes scores, (3) rebecca to roll client fix to ensure numbers for score and non-empty candidates.

mike_infra: Canary done, logs show 200 responses for previously failing payloads within canary cohort. Rolling to remaining hosts now.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for service=rdr-rerank validation=smoke region=us-west-2 user=mike_infra

ben_sdk: I've added an entry in the SDK changelog and a snippet to the quickstart: `candidates[].score should be a number; if you're reading from user input run: candidate.score = parseFloat(candidate.score) || 0` Also published v1.5.0 that will auto-coerce but we advise explicit parse.

rebecca_customer: Confirmed our errors dropped after the canary; we've also pushed a hotfix to coerce the score and validated in staging. No more 400s in the last 15m. Thanks for the speedy triage.

ashley_support: Great — I'll leave this open for one hour to ensure stability then close. Follow-ups: add clearer error message with request_id when rejecting payloads, and document the expected schema in the api reference.

mike_infra: Filed infra ticket INFRA-948 to add coercion flag and to improve error payload to include request_id + validation path.

rebecca_customer: Appreciate the help. Our action item: upgrade to SDK v1.5.0 and deploy client-side coercion by EOD. We'll re-open if anything else crops up.

ashley_support: Marking thread resolved after stability window. :white_check_mark:
